# Simplilearn

> Simplilearn is a comprehensive online learning platform offering bootcamps, certifications, and professional development courses in AI/ML, Generative AI, Data Science, Project Management, Cloud Computing, and Cybersecurity.

Simplilearn provides industry-recognized certification training programs for individual learners and corporate teams, with offerings ranging from free SkillUp courses to advanced bootcamps and partnerships with universities. The platform serves professionals seeking career advancement through hands-on, project-based learning in high-demand technical and management skills.

## Key Topics

- Generative AI
- Machine Learning
- Data Science
- Project Management
- PMP Certification
- Python
- SQL
- Cloud Computing
- DevOps
- Cybersecurity
- Business Analytics
- Career Development
- Certification Training
- Online Learning
- Bootcamp Programs

## Core Learning Platforms

- [Simplilearn Homepage](https://www.simplilearn.com): Main platform offering bootcamps, PGPs, and certifications in AI/ML and project management
- [SkillUp Free Online Courses](https://www.simplilearn.com/skillup-free-online-courses): Free courses with certificates in AI, Data Science, SQL, and other in-demand skills
- [Learning Resources](https://www.simplilearn.com/resources): Free learning materials including articles, videos, eBooks, and webinars for career development

## AI & Generative AI Certifications

- [Generative AI Courses & Certifications](https://www.simplilearn.com/certifications/generative-ai-courses): GenAI certification courses covering prompt engineering, ChatGPT, LLMs, and agentic AI
- [AI & Machine Learning Courses](https://www.simplilearn.com/ai-and-machine-learning): AI/ML professional certificate courses with Python covering machine learning and generative AI

## Data Science & Business Analytics

- [Data Science Courses](https://www.simplilearn.com/data-science-and-business-analytics): Data Science and analytics courses covering SQL, Python, Power BI, and Tableau certification

## Project Management & Professional Development

- [Project Management Courses](https://www.simplilearn.com/project-management): Project management courses for PMP, CAPM, and PRINCE2 certifications with career development focus
- [PMP Certification Training](https://www.simplilearn.com/project-management/pmp-certification-training): PMP certification course with exam prep, mock interviews, and PMI exam questions

## Corporate & Enterprise Solutions

- [Corporate Training Programs](https://www.simplilearn.com/corporate-training): Employee training programs for corporate development in GenAI, Cloud, and Cybersecurity
- [Reseller Partner Program](https://www.simplilearn.com/reseller-partner-program-for-training-courses): Channel partner program for authorized ed-tech training course distributors and resellers
- [Become a Trainer](https://www.simplilearn.com/become-our-trainer): Instructor recruitment for PMP, Agile, Cloud, DevOps, and certification training roles
